name: cdn-sni-block-ech-stateless
description: The same blocklist entry for the CDN host, held by a box that does NOT reassemble: it joins the first two data packets of a flow and reads the name as soon as it is whole in them, single RST+ACK to the client. ECH hides the name from it as from the reassembling one; a plain hello is caught even when cut in two. Op cdn: carries with ECH, the zone's name never on the wire.
analogue: Iran's SNI filter as measured (Bock et al. 2020, IRBlock 2025: 'inspects only the first two data-carrying packets', RST+ACK toward the client), applied to a CDN hostname. Model: two packets, partial read, exact name. The point of the pair with cdn-sni-block-ech: ECH, not a split, is what protects the CDN route, so it must hold against both boxes.
